top_signals.title: Investor Looks to Bid on Club Pilates-Owner Xponential
top_signals.summary: Fund 1 Investments LLC, the third-largest shareholder in Xponential Fitness Inc., the owner of Club Pilates and Pure Barre brands, said it’s pushing for a take-private and is looking to buy the company itself.
